jobs.occupation: Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (w/m/d) (Unternehmensberater/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Manager AWS Cloud & AI Strategy (f/m/d) to join our** Consulting (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/consulting-solutions) **division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You translate executive business priorities into cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI transformation roadmaps and help clients define their future business and operating models.Transformation – You develop business cases, target operating models and transformation blueprints, while driving process redesign and operating model transformation enabled by Agentic AI.Growth – You collaborate with technical teams to define integrated end-to-end cloud and AI solutions and drive strategic AWS pursuits.Leadership – You shape compelling AWS and AI transformation narratives for C-level stakeholders, influence strategic decision-making, build trusted executive relationships and drive business-led transformation from strategy to execution.Your profile- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, Computer Science, or a comparable field.- You bring 6-10 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, and/or technology strategy, including the development of business cases, operating models and executive-level programs.- You possess deep AWS expertise combined with strong executive advisory capabilities and can translate complex business requirements across cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.- You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, driving strategic initiatives from initial concept through implementation and orchestrating collaboration across business and technology teams.- You communicate confidently in English and German, combine a collaborative and hands-on approach with a strong enthusiasm for GenAI and emerging technologies to turn innovative ideas into tangible client value.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Family – Working parents bring huge value to our firm and we want to ensure that they are supported at every stage and feel confident balancing their work and home lives. Also, we support you, If required, in caring for relatives by arranging carers, special leave or part-time models.Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime in your flex-time account and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. A partial payout is possible once a year. We will be happy to discuss the exact details with you in a personal meeting. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups andAnd there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our Experience Consulting team, you will accompany our clients on the way to a new or improved digital product with designs, concepts and qualitative user research. We combine design thinking methods with collaborative workshop formats to involve as many stakeholders as possible from brainstorming to go-live. Help us to leverage the growth potential of our clients in the digital world!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Felix Baumecker at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Architect - Data Governance & Standards d/w/m (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt, Vollzeit, unbefristet Das Team Data & Architecture schafft die Daten- und Architekturgrundlagen für eine einheitliche AI-Plattform und die Skalierung von KI-Anwendungsfällen bei RWE. Als Principal Data Architect – Data Governance & Standards gestaltest du die Basis für vertrauenswürdige und KI-fähige Daten im gesamten RWE-Konzern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Expert:innen unserer operativen Gesellschaften entwickelst du gemeinsame Ansätze für Datenarchitektur und Data Governance, bringst fachliche und technologische Prioritäten in Einklang und förderst eine koordinierte Weiterentwicklung auf Konzernebene. Durch deine Expertise, deine Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und deinen Einfluss verbindest du relevante Stakeholder und steuerst strategische Entscheidungen, auch ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis. Die Rolle- Weiterentwicklung der konzernweiten Data Reference Architecture gemeinsam mit Expertinnen und Experten aus den operativen Gesellschaften, Fachbereichen und Plattformteams.- Konzernweite Standards für Datenmodelle, Metadaten, Data Lineage, Interoperabilität, Integrationsmuster und wiederverwendbare Datenprodukte werden entwickelt, abgestimmt und zur Freigabe begleitet.- Definition gemeinsamer Ansätze zur Inventarisierung und Priorisierung von Datenassets, Bündelung von Beiträgen aus den Gesellschaften sowie Identifikation von Potenzialen für Datenerfassung und Wiederverwendung.- Harmonisierung von Bewertungsmethoden für Vollständigkeit, Genauigkeit, Konsistenz, Abdeckung und Aktualität von Daten sowie Konsolidierung der Ergebnisse, Koordination von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und Sicherstellung klarer Verantwortlichkeiten.- Fachbereiche und Data Stewards werden bei der Etablierung gemeinsamer Taxonomien, Business Glossare und KPI-Definitionen zusammengebracht.- Die Beschreibung und Bewertung von Datenassets hinsichtlich ihrer Relevanz für KI-Anwendungen, ihres strategischen Nutzens, ihrer Zugriffsmöglichkeiten und bestehender Nutzungsbeschränkungen wird koordiniert.- Förderung eines einheitlichen Rollenverständnisses für Data Owner, Data Stewards und Data Custodians, Koordination der Besetzung dieser Rollen sowie Schaffung von Transparenz über Zuständigkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten.- Vernetzung von Expertinnen und Experten über Gesellschaften hinweg, Moderation von Entscheidungen, Koordination von Abhängigkeiten und Meilensteinen sowie Vorantreiben der erfolgreichen Umsetzung gemeinsamer Initiativen. Dein Profil- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets.- Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Architecture und Data Governance.- Sehr gutes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Metadaten, Data Lineage, Datenqualität, Business Glossaren, KPI-Definitionen, APIs und Data Products.- Technische Tiefe in SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Data-Profiling- und Data-Catalog-Tools.- Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis zu führen, unterschiedliche Interessen auszugleichen und tragfähige Entscheidungen herbeizuführen.- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich zu vermitteln. Plus kein Muss- Erfahrung in komplexen oder föderalen Organisationen, Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft sowie Erfahrung mit KI-fähigen Datenprodukten. RWE ist bestrebt, ein vielfältiges und inklusives Umfeld zu schaffen - wir schätzen deine Leidenschaft, deine Bereitschaft zu lernen und deinen Wunsch, dich zu entfalten. Auch wenn du nicht alle der oben genannten Fähigkeiten mitbringst, du flexible Arbeitsregelungen benötigst oder wir Anpassungen vornehmen müssen, die hier noch nicht aufgeführt sind, freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören. Deine Benefits- Eigenständige Bearbeitung spannender und verantwortungsvoller Aufgaben in relevanten Projekten der Energiewende.- Enge Zusammenarbeit in einem motivierten Team mit offener Feedback-Kultur sowie Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.- Wertvolle Einblicke in ein international tätiges Energieunternehmen.- Hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.- Kostenlose Nutzung des Health Centers sowie Angebote des betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagements und der Arbeitsmedizin.- Moderner Firmencampus mit Mensa, Barista-Bar, kostenlosen Parkplätzen, E-Ladestationen und weiteren Angeboten. Jetzt mit wenigen Klicks bewerben: Anzeigencode 93944Fragen? Kontakt HR: HR Services RWE Core, Recruiting Services, +49 201 5179-9050Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Natürlich findest du uns auch bei LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und Xing.Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Behinderung, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung und Identität. #inclusionmattersAbout the role- Co-develop the Group Data Reference Architecture with OpCo, domain and platform experts, covering data models, metadata, lineage, interoperability, integration patterns and reusable data products.- Build alignment on shared data architecture and guide standards through the relevant approval processes.- Establish common inventory approaches and priorities to consolidate key data assets, identify additional data-capture needs and highlight opportunities for reuse.- Align data maturity and quality assessments across completeness, accuracy, consistency, coverage and timeliness, while tracking prioritized remediation plans with clear responsibilities.- Bring business experts and data stewards together to establish common taxonomies, business glossaries and KPI definitions and resolve inconsistencies across OpCos.- Coordinate AI-ready asset profiles covering AI relevance, proprietary value for RWE, access methods and usage restrictions in collaboration with business, technology, AI, Legal and Cyber Security stakeholders.- Facilitate a common approach to data ownership, stewardship and custody, coordinate OpCo nominations and maintain transparency while business owners retain accountability and decision-making.- Convene the expert network, facilitate cross-OpCo decisions, coordinate dependencies and milestones, critically review inputs and escalate gaps. Job requirements and experience- University degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Technology or related field.- Strong enterprise or domain data architecture experience, combined with practical data governance expertise in a complex or federated organisation.- A solid understanding of data modelling, metadata and lineage, data quality, business glossary and KPI semantics, APIs and data products.- Enough technical depth in SQL, data profiling and catalog tools to guide specialists, challenge proposals and review evidence confidently.- The ability to influence without direct authority, navigate competing priorities and bring business and technology stakeholders to shared decisions.- Structured delivery skills, clear communication in English, and a relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. Advantageous, but not essential- Energy-sector knowledge and experience with AI-ready data products. RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you. Your benefits- Independent work on exciting and responsible tasks in relevant energy transition projects.- Close collaboration in a motivated team with an open feedback culture that promotes your personal and professional development.- Valuable insights into an internationally operating energy company.- Hybrid working and flexible working time models.- Free use of the health center, as well as occupational health management and occupational medicine services.- Modern company campus with a canteen, barista bar, free parking, EV charging stations and more. Apply with just a few clicks: ad code 93944Any questions? Contact HR: HR Services RWE Core, Recruiting Services, +49 201 5179-9050We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too.We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmattersErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Datenbankentwicklung, Systemarchitektur, IT-ArchitekturmanagementErweiterte Kenntnisse: IT-Organisation
